declaration.preface: At Novopor, we believe that fair wages are fundamental to a dignified and sustainable livelihood. Our Living Wage Policy ensures that all employees receive compensation that not only meets their basic needs but also supports their overall well-being. By aligning with international labor standards, we strive to create a work environment where employees feel valued and financially secure. This policy reinforces our commitment to ethical business practices, employee welfare, and the economic growth of the communities in which we operate.
declaration.declaration:
At Novopor, we are dedicated to ensuring that all employees receive a fair and sustainable wage that enables them to meet their basic needs and maintain a decent standard of living. We recognize that fair compensation is essential for fostering a motivated, productive, and engaged workforce. By aligning with global labor standards and ethical business practices, we strive to create an environment where every employee feels valued and financially secure. Our Commitment is reflected in the following key areas:

Wages Above Legal Minimum: At Novopor, we are dedicated to ensuring that every employee receives a living wage that allows them to meet their basic needs and maintain a decent standard of living. This commitment involves conducting wage assessments, adjusting salaries where necessary, and collaborating with stakeholders to uphold fair compensation.

Continuous Wage Assessment: At Novopor, we recognize that maintaining a living wage is an ongoing responsibility, not just a one-time goal. We are committed to continuously reviewing and adjusting wages to reflect changes in economic conditions, inflation, and cost of living. Through regular wage assessments, transparent policies, and compliance with global labor standards, we ensure that our employees receive fair and sustainable compensation.

Equal Pay for Equal Work: We are committed to fair and equitable compensation, ensuring that all employees receive equal pay for equal work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, or any other factor. We believe that compensation should be based on skills, experience, and job responsibilities, fostering a workplace built on fairness and transparency.
declaration.scope:
This Living Wages Policy applies to all employees, contract workers of Novopor, including full-time, part-time, and temporary workers, across all our operations sites. It is applicable to all site locations mentioned below. It extends to suppliers and partners, ensuring that all parties engaged with Novopor living wage principles.

The Policy is publicly available on Novopor’s website and shared through various stakeholder communication channels.

Employees are kept informed of updates and expected to integrate these practices into their work.

This Living Wages Policy applies to all employees, contract workers of Novopor, including full-time, part-time, and temporary workers, across all our operations sites. It extends to suppliers and partners, ensuring that all parties engaged with Novopor living wage principles.

Sets FY 2022-23 as the Baseline for tracking our sustainability progress.

The implementation and review of Novopor’s Living Wage Policy is managed by the Human Resources Manager. This policy is reviewed annually to ensure its effectiveness, alignment with regulatory standards, industry best practices, and organizational commitments.

Wages Above Legal Minimum: At Novopor, we are dedicated to ensuring that every employee receives a living wage that allows them to meet their basic needs and maintain a decent standard of living. This commitment involves conducting wage assessments, adjusting salaries where necessary, and collaborating with stakeholders to uphold fair compensation.
Continuous Wage Assessment: At Novopor, we recognize that maintaining a living wage is an ongoing responsibility, not just a one-time goal. We are committed to continuously reviewing and adjusting wages to reflect changes in economic conditions, inflation, and cost of living. Through regular wage assessments, transparent policies, and compliance with global labor standards, we ensure that our employees receive fair and sustainable compensation.
Equal Pay for Equal Work: We are committed to fair and equitable compensation, ensuring that all employees receive equal pay for equal work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, or any other factor. We believe that compensation should be based on skills, experience, and job responsibilities, fostering a workplace built on fairness and transparency.
Annual Wage Reviews: Conduct annual wage reviews to ensure that employee compensation remains competitive, fair, and aligned with living wage benchmarks. This process includes analysing market trends, inflation rates, and cost-of-living adjustments to determine necessary salary revisions.
Pay Audits: Pay Audits assess salary data across gender, role, experience, and location to identify and rectify any disparities. Any wage gaps discovered through these audits are addressed with corrective action plans, ensuring that all employees receive compensation based solely on their skills, experience, and job responsibilities.
Employee Feedback: We conduct anonymous wage satisfaction surveys at least once a year, allowing employees to voice their concerns and expectations regarding compensation. Additionally, we maintain open communication channels, including HR consultations and dedicated grievance mechanisms, where employees can raise concerns about wage fairness.
Monitoring and Reporting: To uphold the effectiveness of Novopor’s Living Wage Policy, a structured monitoring and reporting framework is essential. This ensures transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement in fair compensation practices, employee well-being, and compliance with wage standards, fostering a more equitable and sustainable work environment.
Publish an annual report on living wage compliance, outlining progress, challenges, and improvements in wage standards.
Regular employee surveys and feedback mechanisms are conducted to assess wage adequacy, financial well-being, and workplace satisfaction.
Periodic audits of suppliers ensure adherence to Novopor’s living wage standards, promoting fair compensation across the supply chain.
Communication and Transparency: The Policy is publicly available on Novopor’s website and shared through various stakeholder communication channels.
Employees are kept informed of updates and expected to integrate these practices into their work.
